draft.emotion: a sense of exertion and steady progress toward a summit
notes: Takes に when focusing on reaching the top (山に登る) and を when focusing on the path or surface traversed (坂を登る). Also spelled 上る for stairs or slopes.
Contrast with 上がる (あがる), which refers to going up in a more general sense (such as going upstairs or entering a home) and focuses on the final point reached.

senses.definition: To go up a mountain, slope, stairs, or vertical surface by one's own effort.
